scientific_limitations_and_integrity: The theorem proves exact spherical outward-normal geometry, global completeness, a finite-time growth estimate, and conditional invariant-measure balances. It does not prove all trajectories are uniformly bounded or that chaotic attractors exist. Full 2019 follow-up text remained unavailable; historical originality is not externally certified.
title: Sharp spherical leakage and two-sided completeness for a reversible quadratic flow
